bagPolicy.summary: Only small clutches, wristlets, or fanny packs no larger than 6" x 9" and clear plastic bags no larger than 12" x 12" x 6" are allowed. All bags are subject to search.
allowed: fanny packs no larger than 6" x 9"
clear plastic bags no larger than 12" x 12" x 6"
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking at Dos Equis Pavilion requires a purchased pass per vehicle, with general parking starting at $20 online or $25 on-site. Upgraded options like Easy Out, Ultra VIP, VIP, and Reserved Parking are available for closer access and faster entry.

rideshare.note: Use Gate 6 off Robert B. Collum Blvd on the west side for pickup and drop-off. Tell parking staff you are dropping someone off. Drivers collecting guests should arrive 45 minutes before the show ends to avoid longer entry waits.

concessions.note: Dos Equis Pavilion offers a variety of food and drink options, including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, and Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizza. Koko's Bavarian provides a taste of German culture with sausages and pretzels, while general concessions offer classic snacks like popcorn and nachos with a selection of beverages.
stands: CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible tickets are sold only online at dosequispavilion.com/shows and are reserved for fans with disabilities and their companions. At general admission shows, the floor accessible area at the East and West side entrances is first-come, first-served, and the lawn's accessible sections sit at the bottom East and West corners, reached by ramps.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office is open on show days only, starting at 12 PM, and doesn't take ticket orders by phone. For questions, call 214.421.1111.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Accessible entrances are at the East and West entrances, the Citi VIP Club, and the Starplex Lounge. Guest services can help you at any entry point. Door times vary by event, so check your event page.
